subject: Verified NFT funding and wallet transaction recovery
checks: Real launch factory and swap router deployment with pinned executable verification.
EOA exact-allowance reset, launch funding, Quoter-based swap, LP redemption and mined-but-unobserved receipt recovery.
Real commit/reveal NFT mint, canonical collection/account runtime and immutable verification, NFT account funding, and actual factory token prediction for the NFT payer.
NFT launch and swap execute atomic exact approval/call/reset through SovereignAccount.executeUtility; token and LP ownership remain in the NFT account.
NFT LP redemption, stale account nonce rejection, ownership-transfer epoch invalidation and execution by the new owner.
Inconsistent immutable callsite substitution in deployed account code is rejected.
Simulator liquidity, rounded token/quote consumption, exact trade output and resulting sqrtPriceX96 equal actual PoolManager execution.
Wallet cancellation and same-action fee replacement reconcile the original sender and nonce without sending a duplicate.
Bounded replacement search reports unresolved nonce consumption; a wrong replacement nonce is rejected; the explicit correct replacement hash completes recovery.
Local snapshot/revert invalidates a formerly included receipt, clears its canonical block metadata, and returns it to pending without resubmission.
Opaque-origin storage failure, expired block windows and stale wallet/draft reviews are handled.
boundaries: Local VM execution only; no public Ethereum deployment or funded public-chain transaction is claimed.
This suite does not exercise a live RAILGUN proof or broadcaster.
NFT funding is supported for reviewed compatible operations; infrastructure creation, community sales and auctions remain wallet-funded in the launch UI.
Existing external creator-fee beneficiaries do not automatically follow NFT ownership.
Wallet replacement discovery uses bounded RPC history; an explicit replacement hash may be required.
Current-edition runtime matching rejects older or different account implementations.
